exam_scheme.note: Admission to the MBBS course at Armed Forces Medical College (AFMC), Pune is conducted for candidates who register for AFMC screening based on their NEET-UG scores. Shortlisted candidates (~1,600 boys and ~400 girls) undergo a rigorous multi-stage screening process at AFMC Pune. The screening comprises: (1) Test of English Language, Comprehension, Logic and Reasoning (ToELR) — a Computer Based Test of 40 questions carrying 80 marks (2 marks per correct, 0.5 marks deduction for incorrect) of 30 minutes duration; (2) Psychological Assessment Test (PAT) — qualifying only; (3) Personal Interview carrying 50 marks by the selection board; and (4) Medical Examination. Final merit score is computed as: (NEET Score out of 720 + ToELR Score out of 80) divided by 4, plus Interview marks (out of 50), totaling a maximum of 250 marks.
